repository.name: yashaskn8/Wealthgenie
repository.note: The exact delivery commit and post-push remote SHA are reported from Git after delivery; a committed file cannot contain its own commit SHA.

requires: configured Ed25519 signing key pair and key ID
backend.startupIndexBehavior: Read-only readiness checks; explicit migration creates indexes and backfills expiries.

financialVerification.extractorScope: A narrow current nominal annual PPF rate statement can be classified for review; other financial claims remain unsupported.
financialVerification.currentFindingBehavior: Every in-scope claim returns NOT_VERIFIABLE until exact source evidence, fact binding, effective-period rules, and source-use permission are qualified.
financialVerification.currentProviderReuse: The existing India Post GovernmentSmallSavingsProvider is used by the separate market-data system. Its schema qualification is not a GenieProof evidence attestation or source-reuse approval.
financialVerification.evidenceRegistry: NOT_IMPLEMENTED: no immutable source-evidence revision store or source-to-parsed-fact attestation pipeline exists.
financialVerification.sourceReuseStatus: BLOCKED_LEGAL: required Department of Posts approval for reproduction/distribution has not been recorded.

passport.signing: Ed25519 signed canonical manifests; offline verification uses configured out-of-band trusted keys.
passport.deterministicReplay: Current verifier replay plus explicitly supported legacy verifier version.
passport.history: Owner-scoped bounded revision history checks the stored case head, links, hashes, signatures, and chain continuity. A truncated prefix is not called a complete chain.
passport.revisionCreation: Only initial revision creation is supported; customer reassessment and revision append are not implemented.
passport.financialMeaning: A valid document signature establishes report integrity only; it does not establish source truth, investment safety, or suitability.
passport.export: The UI can download the verified signed JSON passport.

proofBreak.fixturePolicy: A deterministic test-only classifier accepts explicitly tagged SYNTHETIC_FIXTURE observations and distinguishes baseline, parsed-fact change, formatting-only change, duplicate, stale, out-of-order, and unavailable observations.
proofBreak.fixturePolicyLimit: The classifier has no network access, persistence, financial verdict, or alerting and is not registered with startup workers or routes.

privacyAndPersistence.rawOfferRetention: The submitted offer text is not stored; confirmed claim wording is stored only after explicit consent.
privacyAndPersistence.expiryIndexes: TTL indexes for cases and revisions; readiness fails closed until the explicit legacy expiry migration completes.
privacyAndPersistence.deletion: Case and revision records are deleted transactionally from active application storage. Backup/oplog erasure is not guaranteed; retention schedules may differ.
privacyAndPersistence.tenantIsolation: Authenticated, owner-scoped reads/deletes and per-owner quota allocation are covered by service and Mongo transaction tests.
privacyAndPersistence.watchQuota: Not applicable; watches are not implemented.

Playwright Chromium navigation suite: 5/5 passed, including the mobile GenieProof gate and 16,001-byte ASCII input check. Local browser journey uses mock authentication/API responses; it is not a live-backend login test.

verificationLimits: The full no-Mongo backend run has one unrelated existing instrument drift failure described above.

No live authenticated backend browser flow, ProofBreak worker, or production activation was exercised.

Durable ProofBreak watches, bounded scheduler, leases/fencing, event persistence, revalidation, and customer notification lifecycle.
Customer reassessment and append-only Passport revision creation.
